item.title: [infoq] Pi 抛出全新 Agent Harness，还把自己骂了一年的 MCP 装进了核心
item.description: Pi shipped its biggest update of the year: version 1.0 makes Code Mode and native MCP stable, alongside a new long-running agent harness called Pi Durable. Pi Durable handles message storage, task scheduling and crash recovery so an agent resumes where it left off, while Code Mode lets agents run JavaScript in a QuickJS sandbox to cut token use. The team that once publicly rejected MCP has now adopted it, marking Pi's move from a terminal coding agent toward agent infrastructure.

item.title: [infoq] AI 生成的代码，怎么才能进得了工程体系？
item.description: InfoQ traces how competition among AI coding tools has moved from whether models can generate code to whether that code can enter an engineering pipeline, using Amazon's Kiro and its spec-driven development as the case: requirements.md, design.md and tasks.md turn intent into executable constraints. It also names vibe coding's concrete costs — context decay in long sessions, untraceable decisions, and demo-to-production work that has to be redone by hand.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 分享一个开源项目 Agent8：让只有 Java 8 的 AIX / HP-UX / Solaris 继续当新版 Jenkins 的 agent
item.description: Agent8 is an MIT-licensed tool that downgrades Jenkins' official agent.jar to Java 8 bytecode with JvmDowngrader, patching the fallout: newer classes pushed from the controller, serialVersionUID changes, OpenJ9 and signing providers. That keeps AIX, HP-UX and Solaris hosts stuck on Java 8 usable as ordinary agents for current Jenkins. Pipeline and Git checkout already pass in Linux CI, but on Solaris, HP-UX and AIX the author has only confirmed connection so far and is asking for AIX feedback.

It is the reference to read if you want to wire your own tooling into Cursor.

item.description: A personal essay on Juejin whose author watched their company shrink from over 400 people to just over 100, and uses that to rethink the future of programmers, touching on the situation of 35-year-old developers and the combined pressure of a weak market and AI. It is not a technical tutorial but one developer's read on an industry in retreat, useful for anyone weighing career plans.

item.title: [juejin] 每天白嫖 WorkBuddy 100 积分，我让WorkBuddy自己领
item.description: A developer documented how to automate WorkBuddy's daily 100 free credits so the app claims them on its own instead of needing a manual check-in. The author notes they already pay for a membership yet still felt anxious about missing a day, which is what pushed them to automate it. Anyone using WorkBuddy who keeps forgetting the daily claim can follow the same approach.

item.title: [juejin] 一个人+AI做情侣食谱小程序，30天纯赚
item.description: A solo developer built a couples' recipe mini-program with AI as the co-pilot and shares the revenue from its first 30 days online, following up on an earlier post about making just 8 yuan in a month. It offers real backend numbers and a one-person-plus-AI workflow for indie developers curious how cheap a small side project can be.

item.title: [juejin] 基于 Pi，我居然自己搞了一个好用的 AI Agent 桌面工作台
item.description: A Juejin post describes how the author built an AI Agent desktop workbench on top of Pi. Its main argument is not to reinvent the wheel: the model calls, message loop, tool protocol and permission system do not need to be written from scratch. It is aimed at developers who want their own agent desktop tool without rebuilding the plumbing first.

item.title: [juejin] 漫话大模型：7 家中国公司被点名「蒸馏」，他们到底偷走了什么？
item.description: A Juejin article walks through an Anthropic report published in September 2026 that named seven Chinese AI companies — Alibaba, DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Zhipu, Xiaomi, SenseTime and MiniMax — accusing them of distilling Claude in various ways. It asks what distillation actually takes from a model, and is aimed at readers following the data-provenance and compliance debate around large models.
